_comment: Copy this next to your jobs and edit. Paths are resolved against the config file's directory unless absolute.

artifacts.name: dated dumps
artifacts.cure: keep the mask NARROW and the folder out of any sync engine

targets.name: cloud runner
targets.not_for_me: reads the mode from the environment, no local file

_alert_note: No 'alert' block here on purpose -> the console rail (stderr) is used, and it is always deliverable. To page a human, add: "alert": {"command": ["python3", "tools/page.py"]}. Delivery counts only when the command exits 0. The alert text arrives BOTH on stdin and as the last argument -- do not use a receiver that treats arguments as filenames (cat, curl -d @-): it will fail on the extra argument and you will get exit 3.
